catholic-encyclopedia-1913-amalec-amalek: A 1913 entry on Amalec — Amalek, Israel's desert foe. John Francis Fenlon tells the ancient enmity. Joshua fought them at Rephidim. Saul spared their king too long. The Bible's first enemy. Their memory was blotted from history. Their king Agag fell to Samuel's sword.
catholic-encyclopedia-1913-anton-martin-: This 1913 reference piece on Anton Martin Slomšek — the Slovene bishop and writer. Cyril Zupan honors his pastoral zeal. He gave his people books and schools. The Styrian see knew his charity. A father of the Slovene letters. His schools still teach the Slovene tongue.
catholic-encyclopedia-1913-baalbek: This 1913 reference piece on Baalbek — Heliopolis, the city of the giant stones. Romain Butin describes its mighty ruins. Its columns dwarf the modern town. The Romans raised the splendid temples. The wonder of the Syrian plain. Its quarries yielded the giant blocks.
